$comment: Opening-message variants for the hogwarts outreach waves. Only active ones send. One active variant per lane → every school gets it; two or more → ~80% incumbent (best reply rate after 10 sends, else the oldest) / ~20% challenger, split by a hash of the company id. New variants arrive INACTIVE from `pnpm crm:funnel-learn --propose`; `pnpm crm:funnel-variant activate <id>` is Abdout's yes. lang=en is used only for rail `other`. Placeholders: {school}, {deck}. Never edit an id that has been sent — add a new one with `parent` set, so the ledger's history stays attributable.
